subject: DeltaPay compliance discussion — SOC 2, retention, pen-test evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@deltapay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: DeltaPay compliance discussion — SOC 2, retention, pen-test evidence & next steps

Hi Alex / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we all have the same page. If I missed anything, flag and I’ll update.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Audit logs: need immutable logs for user actions and admin changes with 7+ years retention for a subset of events.
- SOC 2: your procurement requires either our SOC 2 report (Type II) or specific control mappings and evidence for the controls you assess.
- DPA & retention clauses: you have a standard DPA template that adds extra retention and deletion language we should review.
- Pen test evidence: you want either a recent third-party pen test report or a statement of planned mitigations plus a timeline for scheduling a vendor test.

Goals from your side:
1) Confirm we can meet the retention windows and provide an evidence package by the end of Q1 (target: 2027-03-25).
2) Determine whether DeltaPay needs our SOC 2 Type II report or will accept a control mapping + evidence bundle.
3) Agree on a minimal artifact list so your security team can sign off pre-contract.

What Redwood can provide (proposed):
- SOC 2: full Type II report (we can provide the redacted report) OR per-control evidence export (audit traces, config screenshots, policy docs).
- Audit logs: export of admin/user event streams (CSV/JSON), retention options, and an immutability/append-only description.
- Pen test: we can share our last third-party report (redacted) and coordinate a narrow-scope test with BlueShield if you require the report to be fresher.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
1) Stephanie (Redwood) — share SOC 2 mapping summary and a starter evidence list (attachment: DeltaPay_SOC2_Mapping_Summary_20270214.pdf) — by EOD 2027-02-14.
2) Alex / Maya (DeltaPay) — confirm whether redacted SOC 2 is acceptable or if you need per-control artifacts. Reply with preference and any mandatory controls — by 2027-02-18.
3) Rishi (Redwood) — run retention viability check for 7+ year events and drop a short options spreadsheet (attachment: AuditLog-Retention-Options.xlsx) — by 2027-02-18.
4) DeltaPay — if you want a new pentest, share the vendor whitelist or we can propose BlueShield (cc’d) to scope — decision by 2027-02-21.

Attachments included: DeltaPay_SOC2_Mapping_Summary_20270214.pdf (mapping + evidence checklist).

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute sync next Wednesday 2027-02-17 at 10:00 PT to finalize the artifact list and timeline. I’ll send a calendar invite once Alex confirms the time works.

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
[Attachment: DeltaPay_SOC2_Mapping_Summary_20270214.pdf (pdf, 360KB)]

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@deltapay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@deltapay.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DeltaPay compliance discussion — SOC 2, retention, pen-test evidence & next steps

On Sun, Feb 14, 2027 at 09:12 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we all have the same page.

Thanks Stephanie — this is great. A few clarifications from our end:
- SOC 2: our security team prefers the redacted full Type II report where possible; per-control artifacts are acceptable as a fallback but would add review time.
- Retention: the 7+ years is only required for customer-facing billing/events and admin role changes. Other event types can be shorter.
- Pen test: we typically require a report no older than 12 months. If Redwood’s last test is older, we would ask for a narrow-scope test focused on customer-facing APIs.

We can target the 2027-02-17 10:00 PT sync (that works for us). I’ll send a calendar invite and include our security manager (Maya).

Also attaching our DPA excerpt that includes the retention/deletion clauses we can’t change (see attached). Let me know if Redwood needs a redline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Alex Torres
Head of Procurement & Security Programs | DeltaPay
alex.torres@deltapay.com
[Attachment: DeltaPay_DPA_Excerpt.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DeltaPay compliance discussion — SOC 2, retention, pen-test evidence & next steps

Stephanie / Laura —

Quick internal note coming out of the call. Proposed evidence approach so we can move fast:
1) Primary path: provide redacted SOC 2 Type II report + an evidence bundle for the mandatory controls Alex mentioned (billing events, admin changes).
   - We will redact customer-identifying details and produce a cover memo explaining redactions.
2) Secondary path (if SOC 2 is not accepted): provide per-control artifacts (config snapshots, GCP/AWS audit exports, policy docs, change logs).
3) Retention: we can support 7+ years via two approaches: export on-demand (we retain compressed archives but don’t surface 7y in UI) OR paywalled long-term retention (additional storage SLA) — Laura, can you confirm estimated cost delta?
4) Pentest: recommend offering BlueShield a narrow scope focusing on public APIs + auth flows. If DeltaPay wants their vendor, we’ll accept their whitelist and set a 6–8 week window to schedule and complete the test.

Action items assigned to me: assemble evidence checklist for the mandatory controls and create the retention options spreadsheet (AuditLog-Retention-Options.xlsx). I’ll include estimated storage/ingress costs and operational notes. ETA: 2027-02-18 EOD.

If we need exec-level exception for DPA language, flag and we’ll loop in Legal / Sales Leadership.

Rishi
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DeltaPay_Pentest_Report_Request_Template.docx (docx, 24KB)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Alex / Maya —

Thanks — invite received and accepted. We’ll proceed with the primary path (redacted Type II + evidence bundle) unless you explicitly tell us otherwise by EOD Thursday 2027-02-18.

I’ve uploaded the starter artifacts to the shared folder (link below) and attached the mapping doc + retention spreadsheet to this thread. In the sync on 2027-02-17 we’ll:
- Confirm mandatory controls (Alex).
- Agree on the artifact list and redaction approach (DeltaPay + Redwood).
- Confirm whether DeltaPay wants Redwood to schedule a BlueShield narrow-scope test or if you’ll supply your vendor.

Links / uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDeltaPayCompliance

Look forward to the call —

Stephanie
